headline_story.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
headline_story.blurb: BBC Verify found that 12 vessels were struck in a single week, the highest count on record. The attacks are slowing oil exports through one of the world's key shipping routes.

stories.title: Zelensky rallies EU support as Trump says Ukraine leader 'more difficult to deal with than Putin'
stories.blurb: Ahead of a meeting of EU leaders in Brussels, Trump sharply criticized Zelensky. Zelensky is seeking more European backing.

stories.title: US senators call for investigation into Ukraine's Starlink restrictions
stories.blurb: Ukraine says temporary speed limits on the Starlink network disrupted its battlefield missions. Senators want to know why they were applied.

stories.title: RPKI now protects 70% of internet routes
stories.blurb: RPKI is a system that helps stop internet traffic from being sent along fake or hijacked routes. Adoption has now passed 70%.

stories.title: Two-Stack Sliding-Window Aggregation
stories.blurb: A blog post on an algorithm technique for computing running results over a moving window of data.

curveball.title: The Economic Complexity of the Western Roman Empire
curveball.blurb: A blog post that looks at the Roman economy through the lens of economic complexity. A good one if you like math applied to history.
